question: How should the lord of the bāṇaliṅga be invited to the desired place?
premises: The lord of the bāṇaliṅga is directly addressed.
He is asked to go by his own will to the place desired by the worshipper.
inference: The bāṇaliṅga's lord should be invited to come freely to the chosen location.
plain_english: O Lord of the bāṇaliṅga, go by your own will to the place desired by me.
